predecessors.name: Pahlavi dynasty
predecessors.text: Mahabad and 'the adjacent cities of Bukan, Oshnavieh, Piranshahr and Naghadeh' (a radius around Mahabad)

successors.name: Pahlavi dynasty
successors.text: Mahabad and 'the adjacent cities of Bukan, Oshnavieh, Piranshahr and Naghadeh' (a radius around Mahabad)

ledger.x: 15 December 1945: the Kurdish People's Government is founded at Mahabad.
22 January 1946: Qazi Muhammad announces the Republic of Mahabad.

wars.name: Iran crisis of 1946
wars.outcome: Iranian victory: Soviet troops left on 6 May 1946 and Iranian forces entered Tabriz on 11 December and Mahabad on 15 December 1946, dissolving both republics.

certainty.note: A Kurdish enclave under Soviet cover; no page gives its boundary and it claimed three cities held by the Azerbaijan People's Government.
